value.rationale: For a canonical sequence-driven plane-filling walk, exact chronological order at self-similar power-of-two frontiers is a natural structural geometric invariant. It is an all-scale permutation law and a direct bit-level point inverse, calculable in logarithmic input length instead of walking a prefix of quadratic length. It refines known geometric coverage, not a fabricated new coverage result, and does not extend to arbitrary frontiers.
